scope: two held-out methods relative to the Element tuning series, both in JDom2

targets.Document.canContainContent: On a Document with one root element, directly ask whether a second distinct Element can be inserted with replace=false. Verify IllegalAddException from the focal call. Build the existing document and the unattached candidate separately during setup.
targets.SAXHandler.startElement: After initializing a handler and registering a prefix mapping, call startElement for the first prefixed root. Verify the document root local name and namespace URI. Use an empty AttributesImpl.

repair: one request per arm on failing seeds, no repair for passing seeds
intervention: execute only the marked setup before repair and supply its outcome; repeat setup check before interpreting the repaired suite
acceptance: judge focal reach, intent and assertion separately; classify missing markers as unknown; report accepted focal coverage for passing whole suites only
limits: single repeat, no repository-wide efficacy claim; CPU setup checks reported separately
